welcome.title: Welcome to BidPilot
welcome.description: BidPilot helps you turn RFPs and presales bundles into reviewable draft packages. Let's set up your first project.

createProject.title: Create Your First Project
createProject.description: A project holds your source documents, extracted requirements, and generated drafts. You can create one from the Projects page.

allSet.title: You're All Set
allSet.description: You're ready to go. Upload a document bundle, review extracted requirements, and generate your first draft section.
